pnpm.comment: Security overrides for transitive deps whose parents have not shipped a patched release yet. Verified against a full build + test run; re-check on dependency bumps. esbuild is deliberately NOT pinned here: forcing >=0.25 pulls a version VitePress's bundled Vite cannot transpile with, and its advisory is dev-server-only.
